The Drive Connect navigation system with cloud-based real-time traffic updates guides you efficiently, while Safety Connect's emergency communication system provides peace of mind during any unexpected situation.

This Limited model checks all the boxes for a family SUV that refuses to compromise. The Carfax report confirms one owner and accident-free history, while the 3.31 axle ratio supports the Tow Technology Package, making it ready for your trailer or recreational equipment. Variably intermittent wipers and the rear window wiper handle any weather condition.

Visit us to experience how this 2023 Sequoia Limited combines three-row seating flexibility, trusted Toyota reliability, and modern technology to create the ideal family vehicle.

The 2023 Land Rover Defender 110 X combines exceptional capability with refined comfort. Finished in Brown with a sophisticated Windsor leather interior, this vehicle presents a commanding presence on the road. The 3.0L I6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers dependable performance, achieving 18 city and 23 highway mpg.

Advanced technology enhances both convenience and safety throughout your drive. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration ensures seamless smartphone connectivity, and the premium Meridian surround sound system with 15 speakers transforms every journey into an immersive audio experience.

Comfort is prioritized with 14-way heated and cooled electric memory seats that adapt to your preferences. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while heated and ventilated front seats along with heated rear seats ensure passenger satisfaction in any season. Split folding rear seats provide flexibility for cargo and passenger configurations.

Safety and handling are engineered into every system. Four-wheel independent suspension with adaptive capabilities manages diverse terrain and road conditions. Electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to protect occupants. The exterior parking camera rear simplifies maneuvering, while speed-sensitive steering adapts responsiveness to your driving speed.

The Defender 110 X stands ready to serve as both a sophisticated daily driver and capable adventure companion. With 40,674 miles, this well-maintained Land Rover offers proven reliability and the opportunity to experience British engineering excellence.

This 2023 Chevrolet Suburban RST arrives in elegant white, ready to deliver capable performance and refined comfort for your family's needs.

- Second row bucket seats with power release
- Dual-pane power panoramic sunroof with express-open and close
- Luxury Package with adaptive cruise control and enhanced automatic emergency braking
- HD surround vision and rear pedestrian alert
- Heated steering wheel and heated second row outboard seats
- Premium Bose 9-speaker stereo with SiriusXM 360L
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Power tilt and telescopic steering column with memory settings
- Heated power-adjustable, power-folding mirrors with driver-side auto-dimming
- Wireless charging
- Navigation system
- 22-inch bright machined alloy wheels with wheel locks
- Four-wheel independent suspension with premium smooth ride tuning
- Perforated leather seating surfaces throughout
- Power liftgate with hands-free operation

The Suburban RST pairs a 5.3-liter EcoTec3 V8 engine with a 10-speed automatic transmission, delivering the capability you expect from Chevrolet's full-size SUV. Achieving 15 mpg city and 20 mpg highway, this rear-wheel-drive model balances power with reasonable fuel economy for a vehicle of this class and size.

Inside, the Suburban RST prioritizes passenger comfort and convenience. The cabin accommodates up to nine passengers across three rows, with second and third row seats featuring 60/40 split-folding designs. Heated seats in the second row and heated steering wheel ensure comfort during colder months. The power driver and passenger seats offer 10-way adjustment with memory settings, allowing each driver to save and recall their preferred position.

Entertainment and connectivity remain central to the driving experience. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the Bose 9-speaker audio system and SiriusXM 360L satellite radio deliver quality sound for every journey. Navigation is integrated, and wireless charging keeps your devices powered throughout the day.

Safety features reflect Chevrolet's commitment to protection. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, adaptive cruise control, rear cross traffic alert, and rear pedestrian alert work together to help keep you informed and prepared. A comprehensive airbag system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control provide additional layers of security for all occupants.

The RST's practical design includes a hands-free rear power programmable liftgate, roof rack rails for additional cargo capacity, and an HD surround vision system that enhances visibility during maneuvering. The auto-dimming inside rear-view mirror and delay-off headlights add daily convenience, while the universal home remote allows garage door operation from your seat.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the 2023 Suburban RST firsthand. This well-equipped full-size SUV stands ready to serve your family's transportation needs with capability, comfort, and modern convenience.

This 2023 Chevrolet Tahoe High Country represents a premium full-size SUV designed for those who demand capability, comfort, and advanced technology in a sophisticated package.

- Power Panoramic Dual-Pane Sunroof with Express-Open and Close
- Super Cruise Hands-Free Driving Technology
- Rear Seat Media System with Dual 12.6" Screens
- Max Trailering Package with Advanced Trailering Features
- Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist
- Bose 10-Speaker Centerpoint Surround Audio System
- 15" Diagonal Multi-Color Head-Up Display
- HD Surround Vision with Hitch Guidance
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Lane Change Alert
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Navigation System with SiriusXM 360L Radio
- Wireless Charging Pad
- 3rd Row 60/40 Power-Folding Split-Bench Seat
- Magnetic Ride Control Adaptive Suspension
- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller

This Tahoe High Country arrives as a clean Carfax one-owner vehicle finished in striking white with an Iridescent Pearl Tricoat accent. The EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine delivers substantial power while the 10-speed automatic transmission with overdrive balances performance and efficiency. You'll appreciate the 4WD capability with a 2-speed active electronic AutoTrac transfer case, providing confidence whether navigating city streets or challenging terrain.

The interior reflects the High Country's elevated status. Perforated leather seating wraps the premium front bucket seats and second-row outboard positions, all heated and ventilated. Memory settings allow the driver's seat and steering wheel to personalize your experience. The power tilt and telescopic steering column combined with the wrapped steering wheel offers comfort across multiple drive positions.

Technology integration distinguishes this Tahoe. The Super Cruise hands-free driving technology, Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist, and comprehensive camera system including rear camera mirror and HD surround vision create a connected driving environment. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the rear seat entertainment system keeps passengers engaged during longer trips.

Safety and convenience features extend throughout. Automatic emergency braking with enhanced capability, trailer side blind zone alert, and rear pedestrian alert work together with the hill descent control and multiple airbag placements. The hands-free power liftgate, remote start, and universal home remote add practical daily benefits. Inside heated power-adjustable mirrors and the rear window defroster address seasonal driving concerns.

The Max Trailering Package includes an integrated trailer brake controller, hitch guidance with hitch view, and extra capacity cooling system—all backed by the advanced trailering package features. These work seamlessly with the dual exhaust system to support substantial towing demands.

The QX80 Sensory is powered by a 5.6L V8 engine paired with a 7-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, delivering the capability you expect from a full-size luxury SUV. With an EPA city rating of 13 mpg and highway rating of 19 mpg, this vehicle balances performance with realistic fuel economy for its class. The sophisticated White exterior showcases the vehicle's commanding presence, while the interior features perforated semi-aniline leather-appointed seating that extends to all three rows, ensuring comfort for every passenger.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully appointed cabin designed for both driver control and passenger comfort. The INFINITI InTouch Navigation system keeps you on course, while Bose audio with 17 speakers delivers quality sound throughout the cabin. Climate-controlled front bucket seats, heated rear seats, and individual rear climate zones ensure all occupants travel in comfort. The power liftgate, heated steering wheel, and HomeLink garage door transmitter add practical convenience to daily driving.

This INFINITI Certified Pre-Owned vehicle comes backed by comprehensive benefits designed to provide confidence in your purchase and protection of your investment:

- 167 Point Inspection
- Roadside Assistance

- Transferable Warranty

- INFINITI ONLY Models Qualify

The QX80 Sensory features excellent safety equipment including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, ABS brakes, and a low tire pressure warning system work together to help you maintain control in varying conditions. The auto high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers add intelligent technology that adapts to your driving environment.

With split folding rear seats and a spacious cargo area enhanced by the included cargo package, the QX80 provides flexible storage for your lifestyle. The reclining third-row seat accommodates additional passengers when needed, while the split-bench design offers configuration options for mixed cargo and passenger needs. Roof rail cross bars expand your carrying capacity for active pursuits.

This vehicle’s safety is paramount, featuring a comprehensive suite of security systems. Anti-theft measures are robust, with glass breakage sensors, interior motion sensors, anti-tow sensors, and an anti-theft system, complemented by power door locks with auto-locking and anti-lockout features. The Escalade also comes with front parking sensors, ensuring peace of mind during every drive. 2021 Cadillac Escalade Safety and Security Features This Escalade is equipped with essential safety features such as a rear seat reminder and front center airbags for occupant protection. Parking sensors at the front and rear help avoid obstacles, while an anti-theft system with glass breakage sensors, interior motion sensors, and anti-tow sensors protect against theft. The vehicle’s braking system includes ABS on all four wheels. Power door locks offer anti-lockout and auto-locking functions, enhancing security and convenience. 2021 Cadillac Escalade Entertainment and Technology Features The SUV features a sizable 16.9-inch infotainment touchscreen with HD radio and a 5.1 surround sound system, including 18 speakers and a subwoofer for immersive audio. It supports smart device app compatibility through myCadillac with Connected Access, allowing seamless integration and control. Hands-free voice-operated phone calls and radio, along with internet radio apps like Pandora, provide entertainment options for all passengers, making every trip enjoyable. 2021 Cadillac Escalade Performance Features Under the hood, this Escalade features a rear limited slip differential, enhancing traction and handling in various driving conditions. This performance feature ensures better stability and control, especially when towing or driving through challenging terrains.

This 2021 BMW X3 M delivers commanding performance and refined luxury in a sophisticated black exterior that commands attention on any road.

- Ventilated Front Seats with Extended Merino Leather Upholstery
- Competition Package with M Sport Exhaust System and M Sport Seats
- Executive Package featuring Head-Up Display and Panoramic Moonroof
- Driving Assistance Plus Package with ACC Stop & Go and Active Driving Assistant
- 3.0L I6 Turbocharged engine producing 473 horsepower
- 8-Speed Automatic Sport transmission with AWD
- harman/kardon Surround Sound System with 16 speakers
- Navigation System with Live Cockpit Pro and WiFi Hotspot
- 21" V-Spoke bi-color jet black wheels with performance tires
- Heated Steering Wheel and Front & Rear Heated Seats
- Extended Shadowline Trim and M Seat Belts
- Parking Assistant Plus with Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility
- Wireless Charging and Enhanced Bluetooth Integration
- Electronic Stability Control with Adaptive Suspension

The Competition Package elevates this X3 M with exclusive calibrations to suspension, DSC, and the Active M Differential, ensuring responsive handling and dynamic control. The M Sport Seats provide supportive comfort wrapped in premium leather, while ventilated front seats keep you cool during spirited driving or summer commutes. The extended Merino leather upholstery extends throughout the cabin, creating an environment of understated elegance.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily drive through the Live Cockpit Pro navigation system, wireless charging pad, and smartphone integration via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The Head-Up Display projects essential driving information directly into your line of sight, while Gesture Control allows intuitive interaction with infotainment functions. ConnectedDrive Services and BMW TeleServices keep you connected to your vehicle at all times.

Comfort features work in concert to enhance every journey. The panoramic moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while heated front and rear seats provide warmth during colder months. The Heated Steering Wheel adds an extra layer of comfort, and rear manual side window shades offer privacy and climate control. Adaptive suspension automatically adjusts to road conditions, delivering a balanced ride whether navigating city streets or exploring winding roads.

Safety systems work proactively to protect you and your passengers. The Driving Assistance Plus Package includes ACC Stop & Go with Active Driving Assistant for confident highway driving, complemented by Extended Collision Mitigation. Dual front and side impact airbags, ABS brakes, Electronic Stability Control, and a low tire pressure warning system provide comprehensive protection. This vehicle has completed a comprehensive 50-point safety inspection.

With 51,555 miles on the odometer, this X3 M combines relatively low mileage with proven performance and reliability. The 3.0L turbocharged inline-six engine delivers strong acceleration with an EPA-estimated 14 city and 19 highway mpg. Every feature works together to create a vehicle that balances daily practicality with genuine performance capability.

We invite you to experience this 2021 BMW X3 M firsthand in our showroom and discover why this vehicle represents an exceptional choice for discerning drivers who refuse to compromise between luxury and performance.

description:
The 2021 Audi SQ8 Premium Plus Sport Utility 4D stands as a formidable, highly refined benchmark in the flagship luxury performance crossover segment, blending supercar-like V8 acceleration with sleek coupe-SUV proportions and standard seven-mode adaptive air suspension. Built on the ultra-rigid MLB Evo high-strength steel and aluminum hybrid architecture, this five-passenger dynamic utility vehicle features standard quattro permanent all-wheel drive, all-wheel steering, and dynamic chassis controls to deliver razor-sharp cornering agility and effortless high-speed tracking stability.

Under the long, sculpted aluminum hood sits a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter DOHC 32-valve V8 engine featuring a 48-volt mild-hybrid system, generating a massive 500 horsepower at 5,500 RPM and 568 lb-ft of torque available from a low 2,000 RPM. Managed by an 8-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission with paddle shifters and Audi's permanent quattro AWD system with a self-locking center differential, the SQ8 launches from 0 to 60 MPH in just 4.1 secondson its way to an electronically limited top speed of 155 MPH. Handling precision is enhanced by adaptive air sport suspension and dynamic all-wheel steering, which turns the rear wheels up to 5 degrees to improve low-speed maneuverability and high-speed cornering stability.

On the exterior, the 2021 SQ8 Premium Plus executes an aggressive, sweeping styling statement defined by Audi s Singleframe grille with an Alu-optic surround, full Matrix-design LED headlights, animation-capable LED taillights, S-specific quad round exhaust tailpipes, acoustic dual-pane side glass, and power soft-closing doors. Exterior contours feature Alu-optic side mirror caps, an integrated rear roof spoiler, power-folding auto-dimming side mirrors, a panoramic sunroof, and a commanding stance rolling proudly on 21-inch 10-V-spoke star design aluminum alloy wheels wrapped in high-performance summer tires.

Inside, the driver-centric cabin welcomes up to five occupants into a luxury sanctuary lined with Valcona leather upholstery featuring diamond stitching, technical Carbon Vector or matte brushed aluminum inlays, and deeply contoured S sport seats. The Premium Plus trim layout features 8-way power-adjustable heated and ventilated front sport seats with 4-way power lumbar and driver memory, a heated power-adjustable flat-bottom multifunction steering wheel, Four-Zone Automatic Climate Control, customizable ambient LED interior lighting, and the MMI Touch Response system. Dual stacked touchscreens (10.1-inch upper for infotainment and 8.6-inch lower for climate control) integrate seamlessly with the 12.3-inch Audi Virtual Cockpit digital instrument display, offering factory GPS navigation, wireless Apple CarPlay , Android Auto , a wireless phone charging pad, SiriusXM satellite radio, and an audiophile-grade Bang & Olufsen 3D Premium Sound System.

Practicality and space utilization match its dynamic performance profile. The generous 117.9-inch wheelbase provides comfortable rear legroom alongside sliding, reclining 40/20/40 split-folding rear bench seatbacks. Opening the power tailgate reveals 30.5 cubic feet of flat cargo trunk space behind the second row. Utilizing the quick-release seatback controls to collapse the rear seats completely flat opens up a spacious 60.7 cubic feet of total flat cargo volume, providing an expansive area to transport camera equipment, luggage sets, or daily business inventory.

Backed by a substantial 22.5-gallon fuel tank, this twin-turbo V8 achieves an EPA-estimated 15 MPG city and 21 MPG highway, while supporting a maximum conventional towing capacity of up to 7,700 lbs when properly equipped to pull heavy trailers or watercraft with total confidence. Safety is top-tier, utilizing high-strength steel frame construction alongside standard active driver assistance technologies from the Audi pre sense suite, bundling Adaptive Cruise Assist with Traffic Jam Assist, Lane Guidance, Audi Side Assist (blind-spot monitoring), Rear Cross Traffic Assist, Exit Warning, a Top View 360-degree camera system, a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS), and an advanced multi-stage 10-airbag protection canopy network to guarantee absolute driving peace of mind across all driving conditions.

Exterior parking camera, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to support secure handling. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and an array of airbags protect occupants in every seating position.

The cargo-area tonneau cover and accessory package—including carpet cargo mat and cargo net—provide practical storage solutions for your gear and equipment. The 2021 Audi SQ7 Prestige Sport Utility 4D stands as a high-performance, technology-packed milestone in the luxury three-row crossover market, combining relentless twin-turbocharged V8 muscle with top-tier executive refinement and true seven-passenger family utility. Built on an ultra-rigid high-strength steel and aluminum hybrid unibody platform featuring standard adaptive air sport suspension and all-wheel steering, this flagship performance utility vehicle completely shuns traditional SUV body roll in favor of razor-sharp turn-in precision, flat cornering posture, and vault-like highway composure.

Edmunds

Under the long, sculpted aluminum hood lies a muscular 4.0-liter Twin-Turbocharged DOHC 32-valve V8 enginehammering out a fierce 500 horsepower at 5,500 RPM and 568 lb-ft of torque available from just 2,000 RPM. This mechanical core is paired with an 8-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission and Audi's permanent quattro All-Wheel Drive system featuring a self-locking center differential. Acceleration from 0 to 60 MPH is dispatched in an astounding 3.5 to 4.1 seconds. Overall handling dynamics are further enhanced by drive select modes, with options for an active roll stabilization system and a sport rear differential for optimal power delivery across dynamic road conditions.

On the exterior, the 2021 SQ7 Prestige executes a bold styling statement defined by Audi s Singleframe grille, quad S-line exhaust tips, power soft-closing doors, and dual-pane acoustic side glass. Body contours feature aluminum-optic side mirror caps, an integrated rear spoiler, power-folding auto-dimming side mirrors, panoramic sunroof, and a commanding stance rolling on 21-inch 5-twin-spoke V-design aluminum alloy wheels wrapped in performance tires.

Edmunds

Inside, the driver-centric cockpit welcomes up to seven occupants into a luxury sanctuary lined with Valcona leather upholstery, technical carbon or aluminum inlays, and S-embossed sport seats. The flagship Prestige trim layout features 12-way power adjustable heated and ventilated front sport seats with driver memory, heated rear outboard seats, a heated power-adjustable steering wheel, Four-Zone Automatic Climate Control, customizable ambient LED interior lighting, a Head-Up Display, and the MMI Touch Response system. Dual stacked touchscreens (10.1-inch upper and 8.6-inch lower) pair seamlessly with the 12.3-inch Audi Virtual Cockpit digital instrument display, offering factory GPS navigation, wireless Apple CarPlay , Android Auto , wireless phone charging, and a 19-speaker Bang & Olufsen 3D Premium Sound System.

Practicality and space utilization match its high-performance credentials. The interior layout offers comfortable seating across all three rows, featuring a power-folding 50/50 split third-row bench. Matte black 17-inch alloy wheels underscore the truck's aggressive stance while the TRD roof rack provides practical versatility for gear storage.

Heated front bucket seats upholstered in Softex synthetic leather accommodate passengers on cold mornings, while the power moonroof with sunshade brings natural light and airflow to the interior. The under-floor storage compartment and sliding rear cargo deck expand storage options beyond the standard truck bed.

Safety systems throughout this 4Runner demonstrate Toyota's commitment to occupant protection. Dual front and side-impact airbags, a knee airbag, and overhead airbags work with brake assist, electronic stability control, and speed-sensing steering to support confident driving. The Safety Connect emergency communication system includes a one-year trial subscription, low tire pressure warning, and an integrated security system with panic alarm.

The 4.0L V6 SMPI DOHC paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission delivers dependable power for everyday use and towing situations. Four-wheel drive capability, independent front suspension, and anti-roll bars front and rear create a platform built for varied driving conditions. With 69,574 miles on the odometer, this TRD Pro represents a well-maintained example that has been driven responsibly.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this 2021 Toyota 4Runner TRD Pro firsthand. Our team is ready to answer questions, arrange a test drive, and help you understand how this vehicle can fit your lifestyle and driving needs.

The 4WD system offers confidence in various driving conditions, while the Magnetic Ride Control adaptive suspension continuously adjusts to deliver a smooth, controlled ride regardless of road surface.

The rear camera mirror gives you enhanced visibility when backing or parking.

Driver-focused conveniences include the heated steering wheel, auto tilt-away steering column, and multiple memory settings for the driver seat and steering wheel position. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration ensure your smartphone functionality is seamlessly available.

Electronic stability control and traction control work seamlessly with the anti-roll bars and braking systems to help maintain vehicle control. The InControl Protect emergency communication system provides added peace of mind, while low tire pressure monitoring keeps you informed of critical maintenance needs.

Interior convenience features streamline daily use. The power moonroof opens to natural light and fresh air, while HomeLink garage door transmitter integration simplifies entry to residential spaces. Navigation via InControl Pro provides turn-by-turn guidance, and the heated steering wheel offers comfort during cold weather driving. Heated rear seats extend luxury to all passengers, and the split folding rear seats provide flexible cargo configuration for your lifestyle needs.

This example also carries a thoughtful set of extras, including roof rack cross bars, door edge guards, and the Preferred Accessory Package with cargo liner, floor mats, cargo net, and first aid kit — clear signs of an owner who took real pride in it.

This 2019 Cadillac Escalade Platinum Edition represents a commanding presence on the road, finished in sophisticated Black with a 6.2L V8 engine delivering the power and capability you expect from a full-size luxury SUV. With 56,646 miles and meticulous care reflected throughout, this vehicle is ready to serve you for years to come.

- Performance Front Brake Kit with Red Brembo 6-piston calipers
- 22" 5-Spoke Alloy Wheels with Ultra Bright Machined/High-Gloss Black Finish
- Reconfigurable 4-Color Head-Up Display
- Advanced Adaptive Cruise Control with Forward & Reverse Automatic Braking
- Cooled Console with Covered Storage
- Power-Retractable Assist Steps
- IntelliBeam Automatic High Beam On/Off
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- Rear Camera Mirror with Integrated Washer
- Dual DVD Screens with Rear Seat Entertainment
- Navigation System with SiriusXM Integration
- Power Tilt-Sliding Sunroof with Express-Open/Close
- Magnetic Ride Control Suspension with Auto-Leveling
- Interior Protection Package (All-Weather Floor Mats and Cargo Mat)
- Bose Centerpoint 16-Speaker Surround Sound System

The interior showcases premium appointments including leather-wrapped steering wheel, dashboard, and door panels alongside a microfiber sueded headliner and unique Sumi Black Tamo Ash wood trim. Seating features semi-aniline leather surfaces with heating and cooling capability for both driver and front passenger. The power-configurable second row bucket seats and split-folding third row accommodate your passengers with comfort and flexibility.

Advanced safety features provide confidence on every drive. The Driver Assist Package includes forward collision alert, lane change alert with side blind zone detection, and cross-traffic awareness. Electronic stability control, traction management, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to protect your family. The automatic seat belt tightening system and safety alert seat add another layer of protection during emergency braking events.

Technology integration makes this Escalade intuitive and connected. The AM/FM radio with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, combined with SiriusXM satellite radio and navigation, keeps you informed and entertained. Climate zones include automatic temperature control with front dual zones and rear air conditioning, while power windows, remote keyless entry, and illuminated door handles enhance daily convenience.

With its Platinum Edition designation, this Escalade reflects Cadillac's commitment to refined luxury. The unique grille design, platinum sill plates, and illuminated entry create a distinctive visual identity that commands attention. The 10-speed automatic transmission with overdrive balances responsive performance with efficient highway cruising, achieving 14 city and 21 highway MPG.

We invite you to experience this 2019 Cadillac Escalade Platinum Edition firsthand and discover why it remains the preferred choice for those demanding full-size luxury capability.

Steering wheel mounted audio controls keep your attention on the road, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preferred driving position. The garage door transmitter adds convenient home integration, and the trip computer helps you monitor your vehicle's performance metrics.

The ParkView rear backup camera provides clear visibility when reversing, while the low tire pressure warning system alerts you to potential issues before they become problems.

The Rubicon's exterior design reflects its heritage with LED fog lights, LED reflector headlamps, and LED taillamps providing excellent visibility in all conditions. The removable hard top delivers flexibility—secure weather protection when needed, or quick removal for open-air adventures. Seventeen-inch wheels wrapped in appropriate tires complete the purposeful appearance.

This 2021 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Willys arrives ready for any adventure you have in mind, combining rugged capability with purposeful design that defines the Willys nameplate.

- Trailer Tow & HD Electrical Group with Class II Receiver Hitch

The Willys package distinguishes this Wrangler with distinctive trail-ready styling elements. Mold-in color bumpers with gloss black accents, a black grille, black Trail Rated badge, and matte black Jeep badge create a cohesive, purposeful appearance. The Willys hood decal and 4-wheel drive swing gate decal reinforce its off-road character. Rock protection sill rails provide genuine utility for rough terrain encounters.

Under the hood, the 3.6L V6 24V VVT engine paired with a 6-Speed Manual transmission delivers the control and capability you need. The 4-wheel drive system, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to handle varied terrain confidently. The anti-spin differential rear axle enhances off-road performance when conditions demand it.

Practical features support both daily driving and weekend exploration. The Uconnect 3 system with its 5-inch display keeps you connected with an AM/FM radio, radio data system, and eight speakers. Steering wheel mounted audio controls allow you to adjust settings without taking your hands off the wheel. Speed control and telescoping tilt steering wheel accommodate your driving preferences.

Safety systems integrated throughout this Wrangler provide peace of mind on every journey. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and integrated roll-over protection work in concert with ABS brakes, four-wheel disc brakes, and brake assist. The ParkView rear back-up camera helps you navigate tight spaces with precision, while low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about critical maintenance issues.

The black 3-piece hard top with rear window defroster and wiper/washer system adapts to weather changes without sacrifice. Deep tint sunscreen windows reduce interior heat buildup. The included Freedom Panel Storage Bag provides convenient organization for the removable panels when you prefer open-air driving.

This 2018 GMC Yukon XL Denali delivers the commanding presence and capability you expect from a premium full-size SUV, finished in striking black with the refined appointments of the Denali Denali Ultimate Black Edition.

- Denali Ultimate Package with Open Road Package
- Denali Ultimate Black Edition with 22" black-painted wheels and chrome details
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Forward Automatic Braking
- Power-retractable assist steps with perimeter lighting
- Power sunroof with express-open and close
- Rear seat Blu-Ray/DVD entertainment system with third-row screen
- Enhanced Security Package with interior movement and vehicle inclination sensors
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Bose Centerpoint premium 10-speaker surround sound with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Heated and ventilated leather front seats with memory function
- IntelliBeam automatic high-beam headlamps with fog lights
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning and rear cross-traffic alert
- Magnetic Ride Control adaptive suspension
- Four-wheel disc antilock brakes with electronic stability control

As a three-row family hauler, this Yukon XL provides spacious seating and versatile cargo capacity. The captain's chairs in the second row offer individual comfort with powered recline and release, while the third row delivers additional passenger space. The split-folding rear seats adapt to your needs, whether prioritizing passengers or cargo room. Premium carpeted floor mats with GMC logo complement the refined interior throughout.

The Denali Ultimate Black Edition elevates the exterior with distinctive 22-inch seven-spoke black-painted wheels featuring chrome inserts, polished exhaust tip, and chrome mirror caps that distinguish this vehicle from standard models. The power liftgate and integrated trailer brake controller add practical convenience for daily use and towing scenarios. The full-feature automatic climate control system includes front dual-zone air conditioning, rear climate zones, and heated rear seats to ensure passenger comfort regardless of weather.

Advanced technology enhances both safety and convenience. The heads-up display projects important information directly into your line of sight, while the rearview camera assists with parking and reversing. Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert adds an extra layer of awareness during highway driving. OnStar 4G LTE connectivity and the emergency communication system provide peace of mind, backed by five years of OnStar Basic Plan service.

The EcoTec3 6.2L V8 delivers the performance expected from a Denali, achieving 14 mpg city and 21 mpg highway. The 10-speed automatic transmission with overdrive optimizes efficiency across varying driving conditions, while the 4WD system provides capability when terrain or weather demands it.

This 2018 Yukon XL Denali combines luxury appointments, advanced safety features, and practical capability in a vehicle built to handle family adventures and daily responsibilities alike. We welcome the opportunity to discuss this Denali's features and schedule your personal test drive at your earliest convenience.

  • Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.

The Rock Creek trim prioritizes practical luxury with its bench seating configuration and dedicated comfort features. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone climate control keep occupants comfortable across seasons, while the panoramic moonroof adds a sense of openness to the spacious cabin. The panoramic moonroof and heated front seats enhance the driving and riding experience, while the power liftgate simplifies cargo loading. Technology integration enhances daily driving. The Uconnect 5 Nav system with its 10.1-inch display provides intuitive control over navigation, climate, and entertainment. The SiriusXM 360L satellite radio delivered through 10 speakers ensures quality audio entertainment. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep critical functions within easy reach, allowing focused attention on the road.

Safety is paramount in the design of this Wagoneer Series II. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags work together with Electronic Stability Control and traction control to protect occupants. The 4-wheel disc braking system with ABS, low tire pressure warning, and a comprehensive suspension setup provide multiple layers of protection for your family.
